labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Asks how to strip markup/styles from a string: a usage question, not a bug or feature request.

items.body:
This is a usage question, so [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) is the best place for follow-up questions. For removing markup, `Text.from_markup()` parses the markup and its `.plain` property returns the text without any tags or styles:

```python
from rich.text import Text

Text.from_markup("[bold red]Hello[/] world").plain  # "Hello world"
```

The markup syntax is described in [markup.rst](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/markup.rst). Closed issue #2016 covers a similar goal for log handlers.
